notes.title: Ability System Rework! - Demo Update v0.3.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878519/7888fb86f7048540a7e5fd3899f2f761d650ecee.png

Thanks to everyone who has played the demo since it's release early last month. We've been listening to all of your feedback carefully, and have prepared an update that addresses many of the concerns so far.

Firstly - please join our Discord community!
Get behind the scenes previews of the development progress, report bugs, and share your own suggestions to help shape the future of the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878519/76bd00b8d955f3a7bb31a476019096e501784e41.png

Demo Patch Notes v0.3.0

New Ability Reroll!
Place on a card to reroll for a new random question, currently only costs 1 token so use it before it gets nerfed :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878519/2cdba0fedcba4db5c76acbbe7d8c9a508ad6fdc8.gif

Ability refunds
You will now keep abilities if answered correctly, lose them only if incorrect.
To balance this, the ability costs have been increased accordingly. In the full release you will be able to ugprade abilities to make them cheaper and/or improve their effectiveness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878519/93ea53bdcf39adaf91bd7c8d9a611fc0fec6ee0b.gif

Random ability
Spend 3 tokens to receive a random ability, very handy for those scenarios where you have locked all the columns and only have 3 or 4 tokens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878519/61b79a0bd49899dc419d3c3a8755729913f368bb.gif

Other ability changes

 Abilities can only be used once per card
 Cannot use any abilities on Rainbow Reaper card

Score Feed
In addition to the current consecutive bonus, the new score feed gives you a nice easy reference for your recent attempts. Important in future as the score will form the currency system!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878519/2af9c5b60c4403d8d115a82a91c160a9100ccecd.png

Features & Updates

 Settings menu (music/sfx volume, turn off tips, video settings)
 Added 2 new categories General Knowledge & Technology
 100 new trivia questions
 Consistent difficulty distribution for each round (13 difficulty 1, 10 difficulty 2, 6 difficulty 3, 1 rainbow reaper).
 Attempted questions will no longer repeat until all others within that difficulty have been attempted (please note, Demo only includes limited sample of ~600 questions so you will still get repeats after a while)
 Complete rework of the save and stats system for future stability
 Sneak peak of the Career Progress / Deckbuilder screen (locked in Demo)
 Implemented custom cursor
 Menu transitions have been improved

Bug Fixes

 Score calculation issue on quick answers (thanks franiis)
 Corrected a number of trivia questions
 Updated scores to show thousands

Thank you to all of the YT reviews so far, it really helps us improve the game and get the word out there.

Here's a fun one from Olexa which has lead to a number of the changes in this update:

[previewyoutube=tI-yjP-fT-U;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep the feedback coming, more updates soon!
